propos: Two levels, never mixed: the brand palette holds the values, the roles hold the meaning.
regle: The brand palette is never redefined, not even in the dark theme. A role references it through var(), and it is the role that the dark theme redefines. A component always calls a role, never a brand colour.
charte-propos: Exact values from the official document. Identical in both themes.
nuances-propos: Obtained by varying the lightness of a brand hue, for the dark theme and for the red fill used in full sunlight.
roles-propos: The only level a component calls. Switch the theme: these are the values that change.
etats-propos: A state has no colour of its own: it points to the role that holds one. Adding a state therefore never adds a hue.
voile-opacite: scrim opacity, the only value in this list that is not a colour.

groupe.semantique: Attention, success, danger, information, network, neutral

usage.charte-jaune-tres-fonce: Yellow text and icons on light
usage.charte-violet: “Not announced” — what comes from the network
usage.nuance-sombre-texte: Body text and headings, dark theme
usage.nuance-sombre-jaune-bloc: Background of the “Replaced by…” banner, dark theme
usage.nuance-rouge-aplat: Fill of the dangerous button, light theme: same hue, lightness lowered to the full-sunlight threshold
usage.fond-2: Block, alternating background, received bubble, pressed row
usage.texte-2: Secondary text: date, source, English title
usage.sur-titre: Text on a heading fill: transient message, active segment
usage.filet-fort: 2 and 3 px rules: field border, under the header
usage.attention-aplat: “Now” fill: session under way, unread, mention
usage.danger-aplat: Fill of the dangerous button, which carries text
usage.reseau: “Not announced” — what comes from the network
usage.vif-jaune: Bright yellow, on dark green only: counter, badge
usage.vif-vert: Bright green, on dark green only
usage.jauge-fond: Background of a gauge or progress bar
usage.voile: Scrim under a bottom sheet or a confirmation
